name: Severstal
note: General sponsor of HC Severstal Cherepovets; the 2026-27 home jersey carries the 'Severstal' lettering on the chest (KHL press-service kit review on sports.ru). PAO Severstal is majority-owned by Alexey Mordashov (77.03%). Proposed tier: concern — the regulator finding at subsidiary Yakovlevsky GOK (claim severstal-yakovlevsky-miner-death-2026) is a company human-rights finding under METHOD.md (deaths, found by a regulator); a maintainer sets the tier. Mordashov's EU/UK/US sanctions do not count under METHOD.md.

why.text: Severstal is majority-owned by Russian billionaire Alexey Mordashov. Russia's industrial safety regulator Rostechnadzor found that failures in work organisation and safety supervision at Yakovlevsky GOK, a Severstal company, caused a miner's death in an underground rock collapse on 30 April 2026; the company was fined 1 million rubles. Sponsoring the shirt of the local steel town's club puts the name on the chest while the regulator's findings sit in the background.
why.messageLine: Russia's safety regulator found that failures at Severstal's Yakovlevsky mine caused a miner's death in April 2026.
